_comment: Claude Code -> local Qwen3.8-27B. Use as a profile so your global config keeps
SGLang serves /v1/messages natively and correctly on this build: it reports real
input_tokens (the old input_tokens:0 bug is absent) and accepts system turns inside
messages, which is what Claude Code sends. So no shim is needed -- anthropic-shim.py
existed only to paper over vLLM's stricter validation.
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL has no /v1 suffix; Claude Code appends /v1/messages itself.
